title.value: Debug code hands-free by voice with Claude Code

introduction.value:
Author built a local speech-to-text and text-to-speech stack hooked to Claude Code via MCP, and used it to debug a WhatsApp integration hands-free while brushing teeth.

Feb 5, 2026

method.value: The author spent an afternoon building a local voice stack on an M4 Pro: Parakeet v3 TDT for speech-to-text and Pocket TTS for speech-to-speech output, joined to Claude Code through a custom MCP. They hacked AirPods stem clicks to be captured, so a click interrupts Claude and starts listening. Claude narrates its work in short, frequent messages, and the session is streamed by AirPlay to a TV.

outcome.value: The author had it debug a custom WhatsApp integration hands-free while brushing teeth, and calls it fun and easy on the back. The source gives no numbers or failure details.

notes.value: Getting the AirPods stem click captured took some hacking, and the stack ran on an M4 Pro, so expect to tinker with hardware input and local model speed.

source_text.body:
Debug code hands-free by voice with Claude Code
Author built a local speech-to-text and text-to-speech stack hooked to Claude Code via MCP, and used it to debug a WhatsApp integration hands-free while brushing teeth.
·
Feb 5, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The author spent an afternoon building a local voice stack on an M4 Pro: Parakeet v3 TDT for speech-to-text and Pocket TTS for speech-to-speech output, joined to Claude Code through a custom MCP. They hacked AirPods stem clicks to be captured, so a click interrupts Claude and starts listening. Claude narrates its work in short, frequent messages, and the session is streamed by AirPlay to a TV.
How it went
The author had it debug a custom WhatsApp integration hands-free while brushing teeth, and calls it fun and easy on the back. The source gives no numbers or failure details.
Worth knowing
Getting the AirPods stem click captured took some hacking, and the stack ran on an M4 Pro, so expect to tinker with hardware input and local model speed.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
